driver.buffering: whole input block only; experimental and not production streaming

format.crc: IEEE CRC-32 of all instruction and payload bytes
format.dictionary: top 16 exact unsigned little-endian word bit patterns, count descending then unsigned word ascending
format.tokens: five-bit index 0..15, escape=16 followed by a raw fixed-width word

fixtures.generator: xorshift64 state=0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 with shifts 13,7,17; values emitted little-endian

strong.settings: 1024 generated words cycling eight u64 values in order (128 cycles)

weak.settings: first 16 generated u64 values repeat for 896 words; 128 following generated words are literal exceptions

pre_execution_scope.raw_fallback: reported and independently decodable, never substituted for the matched CIXG1 metric

receipt_requirements: cgroup cpu.max and assigned CPU affinity
